evals.name: eval-not-unit-test
evals.prompt: Add a test that checks the wording of a product skill.
evals.expected_output: Evaluates the skill with skill-creator scenarios in `evals/evals.json`. Does NOT write a unit test of skill text.

evals.name: version-bump
evals.expected_output: Bumps the frontmatter `version` and updates the evals that the change affects. Never changes behavior without the version.
